classification.habitat: Subtropical, semi-arid and relatively dry regions

identification.description: An erect, branched, tomentose subshrub with ovate leaves, small greenish-yellow flowers and globose red berries enclosed by an enlarged persistent calyx.
identification.whole_plant: Small erect branched shrub or subshrub.
identification.root: The medicinal part is the dried mature root.
identification.leaf: Simple, generally ovate to oblong leaves.
identification.flower: Small greenish-yellow flowers in axillary clusters.
identification.fruit: Globose red berry enclosed by an enlarged persistent calyx.

shlokas:
गन्धान्ता वाजिनामादिरश्वगन्धा हयाह्वया ।
वराहकर्णी वरदा बलदा कुष्ठगन्धिनी ॥
अश्वगन्धाऽनिलश्लेष्मश्वित्रशोथक्षयापहा ।
बल्या रसायनी तिक्ता कषायोष्णाऽतिशुक्रला ॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Guduchyadi Varga, verses 161–162 in the searchable recension; edition numbering may vary.

modern_information.evidence_summary: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) is a powerful adaptogen. It reduces stress, increases strength, and supports reproductive and nervous systems.
